_doc: The reproducible campaign Attestra runs to certify itself end-to-end. The 'goal' lane exercises the autonomous /goal front door on CPU (certified champion / honest decline). The 'loop' lane exercises the provider-aware harness engine, which PROPOSES the GPU torch families (torch_mlp / torch_cnn): on a GPU box (RunPod) they train on cuda; with no GPU they device-swap to the in-process worker on CPU so the IDENTICAL contract is verified before any spend. See docs/EXPERIMENTS.md.

experiments.name: wine_goal
experiments.goal: classify wine cultivar from its chemical assay
experiments.note: multiclass i.i.d.; expected SOLVED with a clear sealed lower bound above the floor

experiments.name: breast_cancer_goal
experiments.goal: detect malignant tumors from cell-nucleus measurements
experiments.note: imbalanced; data-driven competence floor (>0.5); expected SOLVED, not wrongly refused

experiments.name: diabetes_goal
experiments.note: regression-tolerance; an honest NOT-SOLVED is an acceptable, correct outcome here

experiments.name: forecast_decline
experiments.goal: forecast next quarter's revenue time series
experiments.note: out-of-scope framing -> expected honest DECLINE (no run, no sealed peek)

experiments.name: wine_goal_gpu_head
experiments.goal: classify wine cultivar from its chemical assay
experiments.note: same goal, GPU head enabled: the loop may recruit a torch-MLP candidate (cuda on a GPU box)

experiments.name: digits_loop_gpu
experiments.note: provider-aware engine; torch_mlp/torch_cnn proposed when the provider can run them (GPU box -> cuda)
